alcremie.desc: Heals user and allies for 1/6 max HP.
alcremie.name: G-Max Finale

appletun.desc: Heals user and allies of all status conditions.
appletun.name: G-Max Sweetness

blastoise.desc: Traps target's field in a torrential whirlpool for 4 turns, dealing 1/6 max HP chip to non-Water foes.
blastoise.name: G-Max Cannonade

butterfree.desc: Inflicts poison, paralysis, or sleep on target.
butterfree.name: G-Max Befuddle

centiskorch.desc: Traps the target in fire spin for 4-5 turns.
centiskorch.name: G-Max Centiferno

charizard.desc: Engulfs target's field in a sea of fire for 4 turns, dealing 1/6 max HP chip to non-Fire foes.
charizard.name: G-Max Wildfire

cinderace.desc: Strikes with colossal 160 BP fire power, ignoring opponent abilities.
cinderace.name: G-Max Fireball

coalossal.desc: Surrounds target's field in molten rocks for 4 turns, dealing 1/6 max HP chip to non-Rock foes.
coalossal.name: G-Max Volcalith

copperajah.desc: Scatters sharp steel spikes across the opposing field that damage foes on entry based on Steel effectiveness.
copperajah.name: G-Max Steelsurge

corviknight.desc: Blows away screens, hazards, and terrain across both sides.
corviknight.name: G-Max Wind Rage

drednaw.desc: Scatters sharp rocks that inflict Stealth Rock across opposing field.
drednaw.name: G-Max Stonesurge

gengar.desc: Prevents the opposing Pokémon from fleeing or switching out.
gengar.name: G-Max Terror

grimmsnarl.desc: Makes the opposing Pokémon drowsy, falling asleep next turn.
grimmsnarl.name: G-Max Snooze

hatterene.desc: Inflicts confusion on the opposing Pokémon.
hatterene.name: G-Max Smite

inteleon.desc: Snipes target with 160 BP, ignoring opponent abilities.
inteleon.name: G-Max Hydrosnipe

kingler.desc: Harshly lowers target Speed by 2 stages.
kingler.name: G-Max Foam Burst

lapras.desc: Sets Aurora Veil for 5 turns to halve damage taken by allies.
lapras.name: G-Max Resonance

machamp.desc: Boosts user critical hit ratio by 1 stage.
machamp.name: G-Max Chi Strike

melmetal.desc: Prevents target from using the same move twice in a row.
melmetal.name: G-Max Meltdown

meowth.desc: Confuses the target and scatters coins.
meowth.name: G-Max Gold Rush

rillaboom.desc: Beats colossal drums with 160 BP, ignoring opponent abilities.
rillaboom.name: G-Max Drum Solo

sandaconda.desc: Traps the target in a raging sand tomb for 4-5 turns.
sandaconda.name: G-Max Sandblast

urshifu.desc: Strikes through Protect, Detect, and Max Guard for full damage.
urshifu.name: G-Max One Blow

urshifu-rapid-strike.desc: Strikes through Protect, Detect, and Max Guard for full damage.
urshifu-rapid-strike.name: G-Max Rapid Flow

urshifu-single-strike.desc: Strikes through Protect, Detect, and Max Guard for full damage.
urshifu-single-strike.name: G-Max One Blow

venusaur.desc: Traps target's field in thorny vines for 4 turns, dealing 1/6 max HP chip to non-Grass foes.
venusaur.name: G-Max Vine Lash
